gbm_population_evidence.quote: Cancer Harboring BRAF Alterations; HGG; LGG; Solid Tumors
Adults (≥18 years) with Grade 1-4 glioma or glioneuronal tumor (including glioblastoma, anaplastic astrocytoma, high grade astrocytoma with piloid features, pilocytic astrocytoma, gliosarcoma

candidate_evidence.quote: Participants with recurrent primary CNS tumors harboring BRAF V600E mutations will receive plixorafenib, continuously in 3-week cycles until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or other reason for withdrawal.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: or recurrent or progressive primary central nervous system (CNS) tumors
Participants with recurrent primary CNS tumors harboring BRAF V600E mutations will receive plixorafenib

role_evidence.quote: Plixorafenib (other names: FORE8394, PLX8394, PLX-8394): Oral tablets

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational BRAF inhibitor (class 1 and class 2 BRAF alterations; paradox breaker)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: an Inhibitor of BRAF Class 1 and Class 2 Alterations

source_quote.quote: Documented BRAF V600E mutation in tumor and/or liquid biopsy detected by an analytically validated test at CLIA or CLIA-equivalent laboratory approved by sponsor or sponsor-designated central test.
Documentation of BRAF gene fusion in tumor and/or blood detected by an analytically validated test by DNA sequencing or RNA (transcriptome) sequencing.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: absence of NF1 / RAS-related gene alterations (exclusion)

source_quote.quote: Known or suspected neurofibromatosis-1 (NF-1) and/or RAS related gene alterations.

coder_notes: Multi-tumour BRAF basket; glioblastoma and gliosarcoma explicitly eligible in Subprotocol B (recurrent primary CNS tumours, BRAF V600E) and primary CNS tumours eligible in Subprotocol A (BRAF fusions). Every subprotocol requires a BRAF alteration, so BRAF could also be coded as a trial-wide eligibility biomarker; coded per-subprotocol enrichment with arms. Both BRAF rows candidate-matched to plixorafenib (BRAF inhibitor). RAS/NF1 exclusion row is negative selection linked to MAPK pathway (Subprotocol A excludes co-occurring activating RAS mutations); may be dropped as an exclusion rather than entry requirement. cns5_terminology cns5 because the record cites WHO 2021, although historical terms (anaplastic astrocytoma) also appear. Subprotocol A exclusion mentions oral cobicistat (apparently a PK booster co-administered in Subprotocol A), but cobicistat is not a registered intervention and the record does not state it is given; not listed. Ages include children >=8 years (mixed_age). PK is plasma only.
